name: branchleft-shared-infra
comment: @pulumi/gcp is pinned exactly, not caret-ranged. The default provider's version is part of its URN (`pulumi:providers:gcp::default_9_32_1`), and `pulumi state move` carries the moved resources' provider reference with them. Resolving a different patch here would make the migration's zero-diff preview gate fail on a provider change against every resource. Bump it deliberately, after the state move has landed, and read the preview.
